@@U00500@@
The poor boy’s waited too long; we can't send him away disconsolate. Here now, give me your cap and gown. Yes, this disguise will suit me well.

@@U00501@@
(He puts them on.)

@@U00502@@
Just trust to my wits, won't you? I'll only be a quarter of an hour. In the meantime, prepare yourself for our Grand Tour.

@@U00503@@
(Exit 浮士德.)

@@U00504@@
And so it goes. But keep it up, you sorry son of earth. Go on, go, go on scorning knowledge and reason, those highest of man’s powers; let the Spirit of Lies seduce you with his ravishing necromancy, let him blind you with his magic arts of illusion and deceit, and then [’ll have you, and no escape. Fate endows him, this 浮士德, this striver, with a spirit that won't desist, a mind that refuses to know defeat, and in his overhasty headlong struggle he overleaps the earth, its joys, its pleasures. But I'll have him yet. I'll drag him through a riotous life of numbing insignificance. I'll make him flounder, stiffen, stick fast in my lime. I'll dangle food and drink before his greedy and insatiable lips and he'll beg for refreshment, but it will do him no good.
translation:
@@U00500@@
这个可怜的男孩等得太久了；我们不能让他伤心地离开。现在，把你的帽子和礼服给我。是的，这个伪装很适合我。

@@U00501@@
（他把它们戴上。）

@@U00502@@
相信我的智慧，好吗？我只待一刻钟。与此同时，请为我们的伟大之旅做好准备。

@@U00503@@
（浮士德下。）

@@U00504@@
事情就是这样。但请坚持下去，你这个可怜的地球之子。继续，继续，继续蔑视知识和理性，这些人类最高的力量；让谎言之灵用他令人陶醉的死灵术引诱你，让他用他的幻象和欺骗的魔法使你失明，然后[就会抓住你，而无处可逃。命运赋予了他，这个浮士德，这个奋斗者，一种不屈不挠的精神，一种不服输的心态，在他仓促的拼搏中，他超越了大地，超越了它的欢乐，它的欢乐。但我还是会拥有他。我会拖着他过一种麻木无足轻重的放荡生活。我会让他挣扎、僵硬、牢牢地粘在我的石灰里。我会把食物和饮料放在他贪得无厌的嘴唇前，他会乞求点心，但这对他没有任何好处。
